statement: ∀ (c : ℝ), ¬∃ f, Differentiable ℂ f ∧ ∀ (z : ℂ), (f z).re = z.re ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2 + c
script:
# name: ca-holo-normsq-not-re-test
# technique: test fallback (kernel-checked instances)
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HarmonicFunctions.normSq_not_re
# description: x^2 + y^2 + c is the real part of no entire function, c = 0, 1, -3/2; each instance proved by computation or mathlib, independently of the claim.
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['0'], "rintro ⟨f, hf, hre⟩
have hH : HarmonicOnNhd (fun z => (f z).re) (closedBall 0 |1|) := fun z _ => (hf.analyticAt z).harmonicAt_re
have h1 := hH.circleAverage_eq
have h2 : circleAverage (fun z => (f z).re) 0 1 = 1 + (0 : ℝ) := by
  apply circleAverage_const_on_circle
  intro z hz
  rw [hre]
  have hz' : ‖z‖ = 1 := by simpa using hz
  have : z.re ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h1 : Complex.normSq z = 1 := by rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, hz']; norm_num
    rw [Complex.normSq_apply] at h1
    nlinarith [h1]
  linarith
rw [h1, hre] at h2
simp at h2", True),
    (['1'], "rintro ⟨f, hf, hre⟩
have hH : HarmonicOnNhd (fun z => (f z).re) (closedBall 0 |1|) := fun z _ => (hf.analyticAt z).harmonicAt_re
have h1 := hH.circleAverage_eq
have h2 : circleAverage (fun z => (f z).re) 0 1 = 1 + (1 : ℝ) := by
  apply circleAverage_const_on_circle
  intro z hz
  rw [hre]
  have hz' : ‖z‖ = 1 := by simpa using hz
  have : z.re ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h1 : Complex.normSq z = 1 := by rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, hz']; norm_num
    rw [Complex.normSq_apply] at h1
    nlinarith [h1]
  linarith
rw [h1, hre] at h2
simp at h2", False),
    (['(-3 / 2)'], "rintro ⟨f, hf, hre⟩
have hH : HarmonicOnNhd (fun z => (f z).re) (closedBall 0 |1|) := fun z _ => (hf.analyticAt z).harmonicAt_re
have h1 := hH.circleAverage_eq
have h2 : circleAverage (fun z => (f z).re) 0 1 = 1 + (-3 / 2 : ℝ) := by
  apply circleAverage_const_on_circle
  intro z hz
  rw [hre]
  have hz' : ‖z‖ = 1 := by simpa using hz
  have : z.re ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h1 : Complex.normSq z = 1 := by rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, hz']; norm_num
    rw [Complex.normSq_apply] at h1
    nlinarith [h1]
  linarith
rw [h1, hre] at h2
simp at h2", False),
]
instances = [kernel_instance(*values, proof=proof, edge=edge) for values, proof, edge in CASES]

goal.text: ¬∃ f, Differentiable ℂ f ∧ ∀ (z : ℂ), (f z).re = z.re ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2 + c
